title: Grade 7 French — Mon, Jun 09
description: Le passé composé — Day 1 of 5: Introduction and formation with avoir
subject: french

questions.question: What is the 'passé composé' used for?
questions.explanation: The passé composé is used for completed actions in the past. 'J'ai mangé.' = I ate / I have eaten.

questions.question: How is the passé composé formed with 'avoir'?
questions.explanation: Passé composé = present tense of 'avoir' + past participle. 'J'ai + mangé' = I ate.

questions.question: What is the past participle of 'manger' (to eat)?
questions.explanation: For regular -ER verbs: remove -ER, add -É. Manger → mangé. 'J'ai mangé.' = I ate.

questions.question: What is 'J'ai mangé' in English?
options: I eat / I ate / I have eaten
questions.explanation: 'J'ai mangé' = I ate / I have eaten. The passé composé in French covers both English simple past and present perfect.

questions.question: What is the present tense of 'avoir' for 'il/elle'?
questions.explanation: Avoir (to have): j'ai, tu as, il/elle a, nous avons, vous avez, ils/elles ont.

questions.question: What is 'Tu as parlé' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Tu as parlé.' = You spoke / you have spoken. 'Parler' → past participle 'parlé'.

questions.question: Form the passé composé: 'We ate' (manger)?
questions.explanation: 'Nous avons mangé.' = We ate. Nous + avons (avoir, 1st pl.) + mangé (past participle).

questions.question: What is the past participle of 'écouter' (to listen)?
questions.explanation: Écouter → écouté. Regular -ER pattern: remove -ER, add -É.

questions.question: Translate: 'She watched a film.' (regarder = to watch)
questions.explanation: 'Elle a regardé un film.' = She watched a film. Passé composé: elle + a + regardé.

questions.question: Complete: 'Ils ___ travaillé.' (They worked.)
questions.explanation: 'Ils ont travaillé.' = They worked. Ils/elles → 'ont' (3rd pl. avoir).

questions.question: What is the past participle of 'jouer' (to play)?
questions.explanation: Jouer → joué. Regular -ER: remove -ER, add -É. 'J'ai joué au cricket.' = I played cricket.

questions.question: Which sentence is in the passé composé?
questions.explanation: 'J'ai mangé une pizza.' = I ate a pizza. Only this sentence uses avoir + past participle.

questions.question: Conjugate 'parler' (to speak) in the passé composé for all persons:
options: J'ai parlé, tu as parlé, il a parlé, nous avons parlé, vous avez parlé, ils ont parlé — all correct
J'ai parlé, tu a parlé, il as parlé...
questions.explanation: Passé composé of 'parler': j'ai parlé, tu as parlé, il/elle a parlé, nous avons parlé, vous avez parlé, ils/elles ont parlé.

questions.question: Translate: 'You (vous) watched the news.' (regarder = to watch)
questions.explanation: 'Vous avez regardé les informations.' = You watched the news. Vous + avez + regardé.

questions.question: Which word in 'Nous avons mangé une pomme' is the past participle?
questions.explanation: 'Mangé' is the past participle of 'manger'. 'Avons' is the present tense of avoir (auxiliary).
